question.prompt: A circular sprinkler coverage area is centered at the origin and has radius \(10\). A straight pipe runs along the line \(x=6\). What is the distance from the center to the pipe?

solutions.explanation: The pipe lies along the line \(x=6\). The distance from the origin to this line is \(6\), which is less than the radius, so the pipe passes through the sprinkler coverage area.
solutions.title: Distance to a vertical line
